concept.title: Set Up Entities for Caps and Floors
concept.shortdesc: Describes entity-level configuration requirements for cap and floor processing, including netting options and technical short eligibility.

conbody.p: requires specific entity-level field configuration before trading cap/floor contracts to ensure correct processing and tool functionality.

section.title: Treating the Cap/Floor as Two Separate Positions
section.p: If the Net Cap Floor field is set to No, the system stores separate long and short positions. The Tech Short Eligible Indicator (tag 57) determines if a position can go technically short.

section.title: Netting the Cap/Floor to a Single Position
section.p: If the Net Cap Floor field is set to Yes, the system stores one net position. Longs and shorts are netted, and the position is always allowed to go technically short, overriding the Tech Short Eligible Indicator setting.
